bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Invalid CSS selector using jQuery :contains() pseudo-selector
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: The :contains() selector is jQuery-specific, not valid CSS. When tour advanced to step 2, document.querySelector() threw SyntaxError causing ErrorBoundary to catch and show 'Something went wrong' page.
bugs_found_and_fixed.additional_fix: Added data-testid='watchlist-section' to Watchlist wrapper div in App.js line 116

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All OnboardingTour features working after fix
